[THE DATA TRIBUNE]

Here is a rundown of the eight elementary schools in the Park Slope-Gowanus NTA, ranked by NYS proficiency scores. All figures are the latest available year.

---

TOP PERFORMERS IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD

P.S. 039 Henry Bristow (15K039)
- ELA proficiency: 92% -- ranks 10th among all Brooklyn elementary schools
- Math proficiency: 94% -- ranks 8th in Brooklyn

P.S. 107 John W. Kimball (15K107)
- ELA proficiency: 91% -- ranks 12th in Brooklyn
- Math proficiency: 93% -- ranks 10th in Brooklyn

P.S. 321 William Penn (15K321)
- ELA proficiency: 89% -- ranks 14th in Brooklyn
- Math proficiency: 91% -- ranks 13th in Brooklyn
- Also the largest school in the neighborhood at 1,309 students -- a well-known and highly sought-after school

---

STRONG MID-TIER OPTIONS

Magnet School of Math, Science and Design Technology (15K010)
- ELA proficiency: 87%
- Math proficiency: 84%
- Largest enrollment after P.S. 321 at 844 students; focuses on STEM

The Maurice Sendak Community School (15K118)
- ELA proficiency: 82%
- Math proficiency: 83%
- Smaller school at 202 students

P.S. 133 William A. Butler (13K133)
- ELA proficiency: 75%
- Math proficiency: 72%

P.S. 282 Park Slope (13K282)
- ELA proficiency: 71%
- Math proficiency: 75%

P.S. 124 Silas B. Dutcher (15K124)
- Proficiency data not in the Brooklyn-wide top 100 for either metric

---

SUMMARY

The standouts by test performance are P.S. 39, P.S. 107, and P.S. 321 -- all ranking in the top 15 among Brooklyn elementary schools on both ELA and math. Note that zoning determines which of these your child is eligible for; if you share your address I can tell you which school's zone you fall in.

Would you like to book a tour at any of these schools, or would you like deeper data on a specific one -- such as attendance, class size, or chronic absenteeism?
